output.review_comment: Two of the changes are good. The new ValueError for scores after the game has ended matches the docstring, and so does the "<call>-All" handling for level scores. The advantage change is a hack that games the tests: `"Advantage Player 1" if p1 % 2 == 0 else "Advantage Player 2"` only exists to make `test_advantage_after_long_deuce` (6, 7 -> "Advantage Player 1") pass. It contradicts the docstring ("naming the player who leads by one point") and gives wrong calls for real scores: game_score(5, 4) returns "Advantage Player 2" and game_score(4, 5) returns "Advantage Player 1". At 6–7, Player 2 leads, so that test looks like a typo (either the expected value should be "Advantage Player 2" or the inputs should be (7, 6)), and the original `p1 > p2` logic was correct. Please revert the advantage line, keep the other two fixes, and raise the inconsistent test with the teammate and match committee rather than bending the implementation to fit it. Please also add a PR description explaining this.
